abilities.description: After assigning all your starting stats, add +1 to Shadow. Always take +1 to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.0cfcd6fbaf6135d0]{Face Death}. Whenever you try to @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.05909d6310d209a6]{Make a Connection} with another Bothan, add +1. You may start the game with either the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.1e03c8d44d0b3ffc]{Infiltrator} or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.26787f46840c03ad]{Sleuth} asset (you still get your usual starting assets).
